# DOCTRINE — stat changes vs vanilla 4.7.0 (generated by build_mod.py)


## research.json

The research tree: the DOCTRINE ratchet replaces the vanilla upgrade ladders.

- thumbnails restored: 310 display fields (statID/imdName/msgName/category/subgroupIconID/techCode) inherited from the vanilla topics DOCTRINE replaces, 529 derived for new topics (family weapon model + axis badge).
- 66 deleted vanilla upgrade ids kept as inert stubs (no results, never enabled) so the shipped AI scripts stop logging 'No such research' for them.
  - 9 topics: invalid `IMAGE_RES_VEHICLETECH` icon -> `IMAGE_RES_DROIDTECH`
- weapon damage scaling restored to vanilla parity: tiers [34, 46, 61, 82] = +223% total (was [25,31,39,49] = +144%, against unchanged +270% armour/HP research); VTOL bombs raised to +180%; 6 double-dipping vanilla topics deleted.
- crate-unlocked upgrades research 20% faster (researchPoints x0.8); they are the earned half of the loop, so the lab step should not also be the slow half.
- research pacing: +140% researchPower on 312 normally-researched topics; the 222 crate-unlocked (captured) topics keep their original cost.
- 47 research categories removed because the engine's connected-dependency-graph check rejects them once the topics are script-gated: AA Accuracy (4), AA Damage (4), AA ROF (4), AA Range (4), Cannon Accuracy (4), Cannon Damage (4) ...
- `R-Struc-Limit-Labs`: Building.Limit result removed — research-facility caps are set by doctrine.js via setStructureLimits() instead, which is documented and deterministic.
- v2: 222 script-gated topics (axis + signature) ship with empty prerequisites so only intel-crate pickups reveal them; 33 tier certificates removed (tier gate lives in doctrine.js); Breadth credentials script-enabled at 2/3/4/5 families tier-2+.
- 390 vanilla topics merged with 353 DOCTRINE topics (109 replaced by ID), 66 vanilla ladder topics deleted, 7 superweapon prerequisites re-pointed to tier-4 DOCTRINE topics, `"_config_": {"calculationMode": "improved"}` set.
  - prereq `R-Wpn-Cannon-Damage05` -> `R-Wpn-Cannon-Damage04`
  - prereq `R-Wpn-Flamer-Damage05` -> `R-Wpn-Flamer-Damage04`
  - prereq `R-Wpn-Missile-ROF03` -> `R-Wpn-Missile-Reload04`
  - prereq `R-Wpn-Mortar-Acc01` -> `R-Wpn-Mortar01Lt`
  - prereq `R-Wpn-Rail-ROF03` -> `R-Wpn-Rail-Reload04`
  - prereq `R-Wpn-Rocket-Damage08` -> `R-Wpn-Rocket-Damage04`
  - prereq `R-Wpn-RocketSlow-Accuracy02` -> `R-Wpn-Rocket-Accuracy04`
- **Advanced weapons now require lab upgrades.** The lab ladder itself is re-anchored off the Research Module (it was behind crate-dependent Breadth credentials), giving a researchable spine; 19 expensive component unlocks then gate on it by cost -- 3k+ needs the Module, 7k+ Upgrade01, 15k+ Upgrade02, 30k+ Upgrade03. Lancer, Assault Gun and the rail guns sit behind real research infrastructure instead of an 80-minute wait.
- **Vehicle tech freed from crates.** 1 Metals/Thermal-Armor rungs required Breadth credentials, locking Tracks, Body08 and Body11 behind crate luck -- every army stayed wheeled Vipers. Each rung now anchors on the previous rung of its own ladder.
- **Chassis Handling now follows its body.** All three tier-1 lines shared one prerequisite, so Light/Medium/Heavy showed up together and Heavy was researchable before any heavy body existed. Each line now requires the first body of its own size class (Viper / Cobra / Python).
- **The late game no longer dead-ends on crate luck.** `R-Struc-Factory-Upgrade01` required a Breadth credential, and that one edge made the VTOL factory, VTOL propulsion, all five bombs, engines 07-09, bodies 10/13/14 and both transporters unreachable without crates. Three infrastructure topics are re-anchored on the buildings they follow from; `R-Struc-Limit-Labs` keeps its Breadth gate since it grants nothing DOCTRINE uses.
- **Cyborgs arrive earlier.** `R-Struc-Factory-Cyborg` costs 1800 -> 1000 points (134 -> 75 power). It unlocks the cyborg factory, the light body and the legs in one topic.
- `R-Struc-Research-Upgrade03`: removed a `Building` result for `ModuleResearchPoints`, a parameter no vanilla topic sets. Unfiltered, it made the engine assert once per building that lacks it -- 660 log lines in one game.
- **Weapon unlocks no longer sit behind crates.** 53 crate-only axis prerequisites were removed from unlock topics (21 of them re-anchored onto the same family's weapon chain at matching depth). Light Cannon needed an MG crate, Mini-Rocket Array a rocket crate and Lancer two -- at ~3 crates a game that froze everyone on the starting machinegun. Crates now gate the four upgrade axes only, as designed.
- `R-Struc-VTOLFactory`.researchPoints: 6000 -> 3000
- `R-Struc-VTOLFactory`.requiredResearch: ['R-Struc-Factory-Upgrade01', 'R-Vehicle-Prop-Hover', 'R-Vehicle-Engine03'] -> ['R-Struc-Factory-Upgrade01', 'R-Vehicle-Prop-Hover']
- `R-Vehicle-Prop-VTOL`.researchPoints: 6000 -> 3000
- `R-Struc-VTOLPad`.researchPoints: 3600 -> 1800
- Nexus AI `buildDefinitions.js` overridden with a one-literal change: its opening emplacement is the Heavy Machinegun Guard Tower instead of the Bunker.
- Nexus `production.js`: the per-factory busy check aborted the whole production pass at the first busy factory; factories 2..N now produce independently (ground, cyborg and VTOL loops).
- Nexus `tactics.js` `MIN_ATTACKERS`: 10 -> 5, so the AI keeps attacking with the army it can sustain instead of attacking once at peak strength and then never again.
- Nexus `build.js`: factories get their own allowance -- Insane 10, Hard 6, ignoring the derrick curve, so a high-difficulty AI reaches its production ceiling in the opening minutes. Labs/repair/VTOL keep the shared derrick amount.
- Nexus `build.js` `buildMaxsBasedOnDerricks()`: factory/lab allowance raised so a 3-6 derrick holding supports four factories rather than two. The AI was production-capped, not power-capped -- it banked 2000-3000 power it could not spend.
- Nexus now builds hardcrete WALLS: up to two segments flanking each base emplacement, capped at 14. Scripted line-building is impossible (orderDroidBuild takes one tile), so they go up segment by segment.
- Nexus pickets its own oil: one basic emplacement per owned derrick, inside the existing 4+derricks tower budget. Vanilla only emplaced at ENEMY oil.
- Nexus builds two AA sites around its base proactively once AA tech exists; vanilla only placed AA after already being bombed.
- Nexus `build.js`: new `baseTowerDefense()` step, tried first in `buildDefenses()` -- vanilla Nexus has NO code path that defends its own base, only forward emplacements at remote derricks. Up to 4 Guard Towers go up around its base position once the tower is available.
- Nexus `research.js`: the lab loop skipped whenever power < 140, which with four factories running is almost always. The early topics cost no power at all, so it was refusing free research. Floor is now 30.
- Nexus `build.js` `finishStructs()`: no longer skips DEFENSE/WALL, so interrupted defence constructions get finished instead of abandoned.
- Nexus `tactics.js`: attackers regroup on their centroid before committing (no more piecemeal trickle) and alternate between a direct approach and two flanking lanes on a two-minute cycle.
- `rules/setup/base.js`: the standard starting base no longer includes a pre-placed Research Facility, for any player or difficulty. Building the first lab is the first decision of the game again. Advanced Bases is untouched.
- **Every AI can now field anti-air tanks.** Cobra and the NullBot family already listed AA turrets; Nexus referenced none in any of its 21 files and BoneCrusher's only mentions were a comment and a wall hardpoint. Both now build them, and all of them check `doctrineAirThreat()` first -- AA turrets are air-only, so one built against an empty sky is a wasted slot.
- **SemperFi builds anti-air tanks.** Neither of the two lists `buildAttacker` draws from held a single anti-air turret, so it never fielded a mobile AA unit -- only AA structures at home. It now builds them once it knows the enemy has VTOLs.
- **SemperFi no longer fields one weapon at a time.** `buildDroid` takes the FIRST available entry of a component list, so a priority list always produces a monoculture -- all twin machineguns before, all light cannons after the lists were widened. It now draws at random from the best three available, so the army is mixed while still climbing to its rockets.
- **NullBot, Hover and Turtle now see scavengers as an enemy.** Stock NullBot enumerates players as `i < maxPlayers`, so the scavenger faction never existed for it: with no other enemy in reach it built nothing but trucks and was overrun. `enumLivingPlayers()` now includes a hostile scavenger player.
- **SemperFi actually uses what it researches.** Its production and defence lists are priority lists, and cannon, heavy MG, mortar, pillboxes, bunkers and cannon hardpoints were absent from all of them -- so it built twin MGs, flamer cyborgs and MG towers no matter what it had unlocked. Each list now carries the DOCTRINE-reachable options below SemperFi's own rocket preferences.
- **The other four AIs share Nexus's research engine.** Cobra, BoneCrusher, NullBot and SemperFi steer by hard-coded topic lists that DOCTRINE's tree invalidated (BoneCrusher: 110 deleted + 103 crate-locked of 497 referenced). Each now tries the scoring engine first and falls back to its own list, so every AI benefits from the same tuning.
- `camTechEnabler.js` allRes: removed 83 `R-Defense-*` entries so "Start with Bases" no longer grants free walls, gates, bunkers or towers to anyone.
